what: Can the demo identify the near limb from video alone? Estimated-3D hip depth against the camera-derived truth, 11 spent MoVi PG1 subjects.
why: the error budget reports near and far separately and they differ by a measured +1.971 deg on the thigh; mislabelling shows the user the wrong row
azimuth_proxy_cannot_help: it recovers |cos(theta)|, a magnitude, so it gives how side-on the view is and not which side faces the camera

summary.no_separator_exists: Every separator OVERLAPS, and two are inverted: a disagreeing subject sits above an agreeing one on depth separation, and the disagreeing subjects have HIGHER per-frame sign consistency than the lowest agreeing one. So no threshold on any of these gates the failures.

aggregate_only: No per-subject MoVi value is written here -- same standard as the scoping files (commit 4b35950). The overlap finding is a statement about ranges, and both bounds are kept, so it remains checkable.
per_subject: 11 rows, not committed. Reproduce with scripts/phase16a_nearlimb.py --per-subject-out PATH (outside the repo).
